description: This file defines the class RecipeConfigStorageWrapper, which implements StorageInterface to merge two configuration storage objects, providing methods for storage operations and collection management within Drupal.

classes.name: RecipeConfigStorageWrapper
classes.description: A final class that wraps two StorageInterface objects to provide a merged storage interface, supporting collection creation and collection name retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the wrapper with two storage objects and an optional collection name.

methods.name: createStorageFromArray
methods.description: Creates a single StorageInterface instance from an array of storages, wrapping multiple storages into a RecipeConfigStorageWrapper or returning a NullStorage if empty.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration with the given name exists in either storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads configuration data by name, prioritizing storageA over storageB.

methods.name: readMultiple
methods.description: Reads multiple configurations, merging results with storageA's data taking precedence.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws BadMethodCallException; write operation is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws BadMethodCallException; delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Throws BadMethodCallException; rename operation is not supported.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Throws BadMethodCallException; encode operation is not supported.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Throws BadMethodCallException; decode operation is not supported.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all configuration names from both storages, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Throws BadMethodCallException; deleteAll operation is not supported.

methods.name: createCollection
methods.description: Creates a new collection in both storages and returns a new wrapper instance.

methods.name: getAllCollectionNames
methods.description: Retrieves all collection names from both storages, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the collection name associated with this storage wrapper.
